title: Benchmarking Quantum Kernels and Classical Correlator Baselines on Disordered TFIM Chains
description: Comprehensive benchmark and reproducibility release evaluating projected quantum kernels (PQK), fidelity quantum kernels (FQ), and matched classical correlator baselines on exact ground states of the 1D transverse-field Ising model (TFIM) and frustrated 2D J1-J2 lattices. Includes exact numerical diagonalization statevectors, finite measurement shot scaling models, depolarizing noise simulations, controlled out-of-distribution (OOD) phase-shift evaluations, and full statistical verification artifacts.
